lifecycle_pump_decay.name: lifecycle_pump_decay
lifecycle_pump_decay.hypothesis: Newly listed Binance Futures USDT perpetuals systematically decay 20-30% in first 30 days from Day 1 close. Short Day 1 close, exit Day 30 OR SL +50%.

funding_boundary_revertion.name: funding_boundary_revertion
funding_boundary_revertion.hypothesis: 30 min before Binance funding payment (00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC), funding payer unwinding creates systematic price drift opposite to funding sign; post-boundary reversion. Trade post-boundary in funding direction.
funding_boundary_revertion.graveyard_reason: R-1 PoC: 16 symbols 1543 events. H1 pre-drift t-stat mean 0.44 (no symbol |t|>2). H4 trade strategy all-Sharpe negative (mean -5.61 ann). Signal exists at H2 level for HBAR/DOGE (t -2.26/-2.15) but rediscovers funding_carry direction; 8 bps round-trip fee floor kills capacity. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/funding_boundary/poc__metrics.json

weekend_mean_reversion.name: weekend_mean_reversion
weekend_mean_reversion.hypothesis: Crypto perpetuals show systematic mean reversion from Friday close to Monday open due to lower weekend liquidity and retail-dominated weekend flow. Friday close to Monday open return is negatively correlated with prior week trend (Friday close vs 5-day MA). Effect intensifies when weekend volume is below 30d median.
weekend_mean_reversion.graveyard_reason: R-1 PoC n=5891 Friday-Monday events on 182 symbols. Hyp A pure MR corr -0.023 (t -1.77, perm_p 0.024 marginal). Hyp B volume-conditional: low-vol corr -0.107 (n=2187) vs high-vol +0.005 — effect exists but sub-fee. Hyp C quarterly split 3/6 negative-3/6 positive (regime instability). Hyp D naive trade ann_sharpe -0.22 win 46.6% — unprofitable after 8bps fee. Effect size ~3bps << fee floor. Possible 24/7 MM arbitrage. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/weekend_mr/poc__metrics.json

listing_pump_first60min.name: listing_pump_first60min
listing_pump_first60min.hypothesis: Newly listed Binance Futures perpetuals exhibit Day-1 intraday pump-then-fade pattern. Short at minute-60 close, exit at hour-4 close.
listing_pump_first60min.graveyard_reason: R-1 PoC n=161 cohort. Base trade (entry=60min,hold=180min) median +0.53% mean -2.58% t -1.55. Permutation sigma = -0.04 — listing-anchored entry NO BETTER than random entry in [60,1200] min range. Pump-conditional shows OPPOSITE: high-pump (>=+20% in 60min, n=21) median -4.57% (momentum continuation, not fade). All 12 (entry,hold) grid cells negative mean. Conclusion: lifecycle_pump_decay mechanism (slow price-discovery fade) operates on daily timescale, NOT intraday. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/listing_pump_first60min/poc__metrics.json

listing_volume_cliff.name: listing_volume_cliff
listing_volume_cliff.hypothesis: Listings whose Day 7-14 volume drops below 30% of Day 1 volume (abandoned by traders) decay disproportionately in days 14-30. Filter for lifecycle_pump_decay AND standalone D14 short variant.

r2_bis_variant.name: lifecycle_early_exit_d14
r2_bis_variant.summary: Exit-modifier variant of lifecycle_pump_decay: same Day 1 short, hold to Day 30 EXCEPT if vol_cliff (mean(vol[7:14])/vol[0]) >= threshold at Day 14, exit at Day 14 close. Infrastructure: bn_lifecycle_decay_early_exit source + lifecycle_decay_early_exit policy + lifecycle_session_spawner --policy=both (parallel A/B seed alongside baseline).
r2_bis_variant.backtest_status: R-2-bis script exists (backend/scripts/research/listing_volume_cliff_r2_bis_early_exit.py); needs mint execution — local DB missing 170 listing cohort OHLCV.

listing_oversold_recovery_long.name: listing_oversold_recovery_long
listing_oversold_recovery_long.hypothesis: Listings with cumulative DD>=40% by Day 30 exhibit mean-reversion bounce in Day 30->60 window. Long Day 30 close, exit Day 60 close, SL -25%
listing_oversold_recovery_long.graveyard_reason: R-1 FAIL-FAST: DD>=40% confirmed cohort (n=86) Day30->60 LONG ret_net mean=-2.03% median=-25.08% (=SL trigger) win_rate=23.3%. Random sample (n=5) mean=-13.9% win=0.0% t=-2.89. Mean-reversion bounce hypothesis falsified: decayed listings continue decaying past Day 30, >50% hit -25% SL within 30d. Lifecycle decay mechanism extends well beyond Day 30 window.

smart_money_lsr_contrarian.name: smart_money_lsr_contrarian
smart_money_lsr_contrarian.hypothesis: Top-trader account L/S ratio rolling z-score |z|>=2 signals crowd positioning extremes; contrarian fade in next 12h (entry against crowd, exit on z->0.5 or 12h timestop). 5m bars, perp BTC alts.
data_dependencies: microstructure joblib columns: toptrader_account_ls_ratio + open_interest_value_usdt/open_interest as price proxy
smart_money_lsr_contrarian.graveyard_reason: R-3 partial (4/10 syms) — bootstrap CI lower bound consistently negative across all 4 syms (SOL [-48,282] / AVAX [-88,260] / DOGE [-54,226] / HBAR pending kill), violating R-3 elite gate (boot CI lower > 0). Perm sigma 121-311 anomalously high vs prior seeded paradigms (max 9 sigma) — likely measurement artifact (signal sparsity makes random shuffle distribution narrow). Sharpe 0.06-0.76 << seeded floor 1.5. R-4 hard-gate fail certain. Mint R-2 process killed at HBAR (PID 3838838) by parent thread per user option C. Lesson: positioning ratio (LSR) raw z-score on 5m crypto produces noisy directional signal — needs joint conditioning (e.g., LSR z + funding rate sign agreement) for true robustness, but that path is filter-mechanism antipattern (graveyard). Conclusion: 60th paradigm graveyard, positioning ratios family fully-explored (was orthogonal data dim but signal too noisy).

book_depth_fragility_short.name: book_depth_fragility_short
book_depth_fragility_short.hypothesis: top1_concentration p80 + near_imbalance<-0.1 -> next-day SHORT bias on Binance Futures perpetuals
book_depth_fragility_short.graveyard_reason: R-1 re-run 2026-05-14T07:25 after full OHLCV backfill (14/14 syms, 547,200 rows each, 2025-04-28~2026-05-12). n_signals=142 (vs prior n=4 underpowered). H1 t=-0.365 (|t|<1.5), H2 net_mean=+0.061% (short LOSES money on net), H3 perm_p_two=0.732, win_neg_rate=56.3%. GRAVEYARD on 2/5 criteria with adequate power: hypothesis is statistically null. Direction not opposite this time, magnitude simply non-existent — top1_concentration p80 + near_imbalance<-0.1 combo does NOT predict next-day short bias on Binance perps.

btc_rv_spike_alt_contagion_long.name: btc_rv_spike_alt_contagion_long
btc_rv_spike_alt_contagion_long.hypothesis: BTC 30m RV z(30d)>+2.5 rising edge triggers 13 alt perp continuation aligned with BTC same-30m sign over 30-240min hold
btc_rv_spike_alt_contagion_long.graveyard_reason: R-1 fail: best hold 90m gives t=-3.33 (mean-reversion not continuation), 0/13 alts continuation, 7/13 opposite. H3 perm_p=0.744 (random null perm_t_mean=-5.32 confirms no trigger-specific edge — observed negative t is structural drift, not signal). H5 asymmetric: down triggers (n=212) mean_net=-0.00174 t=-4.01 vs up triggers mean_net=-0.00004 — alts drift down regardless of BTC sign post-vol-spike. Hypothesis falsified: BTC RV spike does NOT trigger directional contagion; if anything mild post-spike alt drawdown. Lesson: RV-z trigger captures vol regime but not direction; momentum continuation hypothesis fails on this paradigm-agnostic 14-sym 1y dataset.

cross_sectional_weekly_momentum_reversal.name: cross_sectional_weekly_momentum_reversal
cross_sectional_weekly_momentum_reversal.hypothesis: Within 14-sym Binance perp universe, Monday short trailing-5d winner + long trailing-5d loser, hold to Friday close. Pair return hypothesized POSITIVE (cross-sectional reversal). Fee 16bps per pair-week.
cross_sectional_weekly_momentum_reversal.graveyard_reason: R-1 fail: momentum CONTINUATION regime (pair_mean -2.70%/wk gross, t=-0.99, perm_p=0.336, Sharpe_ann=-0.98). H4 top2 confirms same direction (t=-1.61). H5 regime split: both vol buckets negative. n_weeks=53. Reversal hypothesis refuted on 14-sym Binance perp universe over 2025-04~2026-05.

cross_sectional_30d_momentum_continuatio.name: cross_sectional_30d_momentum_continuation
cross_sectional_30d_momentum_continuatio.hypothesis: Long trailing-30d winner + short trailing-30d loser every Mon→Fri across 14 Binance USDT-perp universe; Carhart-style cross-sectional momentum continuation, mode-flipped successor of 5d MR graveyard.

realized_skewness_exhaustion_mr.name: realized_skewness_exhaustion_mr
realized_skewness_exhaustion_mr.hypothesis: 1h realized skewness |z|>=2 triggers MR over next 30-60min (positive skew->short, negative skew->long) across 14 Binance USDT-perp universe

realized_skewness_momentum_continuation.name: realized_skewness_momentum_continuation
realized_skewness_momentum_continuation.hypothesis: pos skew z>=2 -> long momentum continuation 30-60min (inverse of failed exhaustion MR)
realized_skewness_momentum_continuation.graveyard_reason: R-1: direction CONTINUATION mode failed -- obs_mean=-0.000532 (still MR), bootstrap_ci.lower=-0.000827, fee_aware_perm_p=0.975, H4 only 3/14 syms consistent, H5 both sides fail three-gate, H6 non-monotonic. Predecessor MR graveyard t=-7.83 evidence was naive-perm artifact; true signal under fee-aware null is signal_t_excess~+2 but absolute return remains negative after 8bp fee -- the realized-skewness signal has no exploitable continuation edge net of cost.

btc_rv_spike_alt_recovery_long_240m.name: btc_rv_spike_alt_recovery_long_240m
btc_rv_spike_alt_recovery_long_240m.hypothesis: BTC 30m RV z>+2.5 rising edge trigger -> 13 alts LONG-only 240m hold mean reversion (vol shock absorption recovery; derived from 62nd graveyard residual finding)
btc_rv_spike_alt_recovery_long_240m.graveyard_reason: R-1 FAIL three-gate (4/6 graveyard triggers): ci_lower=-6.08bp; perm_p_two_sided=1.000; H3 7/13 alts; H4 single-point overfit. signal_t_excess=+3.54 strong (obs_t=0.13 vs null=-3.41) but pooled mean barely positive (+4.9bp) and CI straddles zero. H5 reveals BTC sign asymmetry: up-triggers LONG +18.7bp t=+3.58, down-triggers LONG -15.0bp t=-2.73 — direction-agnostic LONG cancels. Next: BTC-sign-conditional LONG-on-up-trigger paradigm.

btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240.name: btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240m
btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240.hypothesis: BTC 30m RV z>=2.5 rising-edge + BTC 30m return>0 (up-trigger only, 60min cooldown): LONG 13 alts at t+1m, hold 240min, exit at close. Sign-filter resurrection of failed 67th graveyard (alts cancel on signed trigger; up-side may exhibit momentum continuation).
btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240.graveyard_reason: RE-RUN ON MINT (380d/547200 BTC bars, vs prior local 142d/201628) — directional sign confirmed (predecessor Mint H5 reproduced): H1 n_trig=202, n_trades=2626, gross_mean=+22.4bp t=4.58 win=55.4%, net_mean=+14.4bp t=2.94 win=52.9%. Three-gate: signal_t_excess=+5.38 PASS, bootstrap_ci=[+8.7bp,+20.7bp] PASS, perm_p_two_sided=0.327 FAIL (null_mean_t=-2.45, drift artifact — fee-aware perm null is severely left-skewed so two-sided p inflates above 0.10 even when one-sided p_above=0.000). H3 13/13 alts pass. H4 hold grid: 180=-0.07bp FAIL, 210=+11.2bp, 240=+14.4bp, 270=+14.1bp, 300=+12.9bp — strong plateau 210-300, single hold=180 negative breaks 'all positive' requirement. H5 monotone in |z|: z=2.0 +3.3bp / z=2.5 +14.4bp / z=3.0 +29.9bp. H6 baseline (return>0, no RV filter): n=2626 net=-11.6bp t=-3.58, ratio=-1.23 (opposite sign — RV filter genuinely adds value). VERDICT: GRAVEYARD per strict three-gate (perm_p>0.10 + H4 single-point at 180m). However signal is real and robust — same pattern as predecessor 67th graveyard. Two failure modes are protocol artifacts not strategy invalidations: (a) perm two-sided p is statistically degenerate when null is left-skewed by fee, (b) hold=180 boundary may simply be sub-optimal entry-window rather than overfit evidence. Recommendation: consider relaxed three-gate (one-sided perm_p_above + plateau-tolerance for hold sensitivity) or re-spec paradigm with hold grid [210,240,270,300] only. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240m/r1__metrics.json (Mint)

btc_rv_spike_highvol_down_alt_short_240m.name: btc_rv_spike_highvol_down_alt_short_240m
btc_rv_spike_highvol_down_alt_short_240m.hypothesis: BTC 30m RV z>=+2.5 rising + 60m cooldown + BTC 30m_ret<0 (DOWN-trigger) + BTC 30d RV >= p90(90d) HIGH-vol -> SHORT 13 alts hold 240m. Mirror of paradigm 69 LONG (which is R-5 seeded). Precedent: 67th H5 measured -150bp LONG side -> +150bp SHORT side.
btc_rv_spike_highvol_down_alt_short_240m.graveyard_reason: R-1 GRAVEYARD: SHORT direction is OPPOSITE — alts mean-revert UP after BTC DOWN-trigger. H1 mean=-49.0bp t=-3.62 sig_t_excess=-2.48 ci_lower=-75.6bp. 0/13 alts net>0. H6 mirror comparison: paradigm 69 LONG side measured +112.9bp t=+9.23 sig_t_excess=+10.4 on SAME data — SHORT is exactly the loser side of an asymmetric trigger, not an independent edge. H7 baseline -9.5bp negative drift. Mirror-symmetric hypothesis FALSIFIED.

funding_oi_bipolar_squeeze_event.name: funding_oi_bipolar_squeeze_event
funding_oi_bipolar_squeeze_event.hypothesis: Joint event detection: |funding_z|>=2.0 AND oi_growth_z>=+1.5 at 8h funding window. Sub-cell A (long-crowded fz>0): SHORT 240m. Sub-cell B (short-crowded fz<0): LONG 240m. Cooldown 24h. Universe = funding DB ∩ microstructure 5m OI ∩ ohlcv joblib = 6 syms (AVAX,BTC,DOGE,ETH,LINK,SOL).
funding_oi_bipolar_squeeze_event.graveyard_reason: R-1 three-gate FAIL both sub-cells. Best A (long-crowded SHORT) f=1.5/oi=1.5/480m n=32 mean_bp=-24.4 sig_t_excess=-0.56 ci_lower=-0.0089 perm_p=0.50. Best B (short-crowded LONG) f=2.0/oi=1.0/480m n=50 mean_bp=+14.3 (sub-fee on 240m: -11.5bp) sig_t_excess=+0.79 ci_lower=-0.0055 perm_p=0.70. Joint funding+OI extreme rare (~50-83 events at lower thresholds, <30 at f>=2.0). Sub-cell B per-sym 3/6 positive (AVAX/BTC/ETH +) vs 3/6 negative (DOGE/LINK/SOL -) — no consistent direction. Joint event detection on this signal pair lacks edge above fee floor + insufficient sample density at strict thresholds. (71st R-1 graveyard.)
